summary_en: 19,109,700 shares to be cancelled (15.6% of shares outstanding pre-cancellation). Effective 2 Aug 2026. Post-cancellation: 103,035,845 shares outstanding; 10,451,578 treasury shares remain (10.1% of post-cancel total).
title_en: Notice of Cancellation of Treasury Shares
translation_en_brief: On 5 Aug 2026, DeNA's board of directors resolved to cancel 19,109,700 treasury shares (15.6% of shares outstanding before cancellation) effective 31 Aug 2026 pursuant to Companies Act Article 178. The cancellation implements the company's prior announcement (27 Feb 2026) that all shares acquired under the buyback program would be cancelled. Following the cancellation, outstanding shares will total 103,035,845 and treasury shares will number 10,451,578 (10.1% of the post-cancellation total), based on treasury holdings as of 31 Jul 2026.
